subject: Following up on your call about room 402
body:
Hi Robert,

We are very sorry to hear the air conditioning in room 402 has not been working - that is not the stay we want you to have. Our Guest Relations team will personally call you back within the hour to get this sorted right away.
ai_suggested_reply: Hi Robert, we are very sorry about the air conditioning in room 402. We are sending maintenance up immediately and would like to offer you a complimentary breakfast for the inconvenience - please let us know if you would prefer to move rooms instead.
